{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hvarnec Junior Scout League''' was an organization based in [[Meirm City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. The League was known to organize craft sales at local marketplaces, an event that was usually covered by freelance [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Lan Demoal]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
